title: Security release gate: harden authentication, tenant boundary, and agent identities before public deployment
body:
Security hardening implementation is now in draft PR #19, stacked on authentication PR #17. The latest targeted CI (full staging, dependency audit, secret scan) must be green at the final review SHA before merging. **This issue remains OPEN: production security certification requires independent review and deployment configuration.**

## Implemented and automatically exercised

- [x] PostgreSQL-backed login throttling, per account/direct client IP; 15-minute window, 429, audited failures (live synthetic tests).
- [x] Structured redacted audit events for logins, logouts, access denial, user/membership/worker changes, and modifying requests; platform-admin-only read API. **Database tamper resistance/retention still open below.**
- [x] Cross-organization role/membership gating, nested ETL, metrics/logs/alerts read and write negatives, forged relation tests. **Independent SQL/ORM threat review still open.**
- [x] Separate scoped, expiring, revocable worker tokens without human session reuse; draft PR #20 adds scoped leased claims, one-job/one-result ingestion, nonce fencing, local+server HTTPS egress and recurring scheduling. **Production network-layer controls and independent review remain open.**
- [x] Platform-admin Access Management UI, creation/deactivation, password reset, role and membership lifecycle; session revocation and last-active-admin safeguard.
- [x] API production HTTPS guard, CORS allowlist, security headers, disabled production Swagger/OpenAPI.
- [x] Dependency checks (Python pip-audit, npm production audit), repository Git history secret scan, narrow reviewed single-line Gitleaks false-positive exception.
- [x] Upgraded FastAPI/Starlette to patched compatible versions, generated and committed frontend package-lock.json, CI uses npm ci.
- [x] Input checks reject embedded credentials and URL userinfo; existing monitoring configuration API output redacts legacy embedded values, and validation errors do not echo rejected inputs.

## Still blocking an external production release

- [ ] Independent security code review of **all** routers, services, nested queries, raw SQL bypass, privilege escalation and audit integrity; extend tests for unsupported rule/agent paths.
- [ ] Enforce tamper-resistant audit storage, DB role separation, privacy/retention/archival and cleanup; audit events have a PostgreSQL UPDATE/DELETE rejection trigger but are **not** DB-owner-proof/cryptographically immutable.
- [ ] Review the implemented agent pull transport, leased nonce claims, replay-resistant ingestion, exact-host/CIDR policy, DNS pinning, TLS validation and GET-only probes in draft PR #20; implement/test mandatory network firewall/container sandbox, credentials-provider integration and deeper provenance/attestation.
- [ ] Deploy a real secret-provider integration and remove/rotate any older credentials already stored in databases or Git history. Redaction does **not** erase existing secrets at rest.
- [ ] Verify TLS termination and trusted reverse-proxy IP derivation, static **React** CSP/XSS hardening, backup restore/rollback and nonempty database migration.
- [ ] Test multi-instance rate limits and session under load, proxy-shared IP lockouts, incident recovery and account recovery.
- [ ] Independent manual pen test / maintainer acceptance and explicit permission for production/public deployment.

Documentation: [SECURITY.md](../blob/security/phase2-release-hardening/SECURITY.md), [Security release checklist](../blob/security/phase2-release-hardening/docs/SECURITY_RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md).

**Do not close issue #18 or #2 on the basis of staging green alone. No main merge or production deploy has been performed.**

## Latest implementation — remote agent PR #20

- [x] Durable scheduled remote HTTP job dispatch with explicit collector-worker assignment and PostgreSQL lease claims.
- [x] Authenticated outbound agent claim and bounded evidence result routes, with tenant/worker relationship validation and replay/idempotence tests.
- [x] Strict HTTPS GET, verified hostname, all-DNS-answer CIDR check, pinned connection, no redirects, worker-local policy overlay and metadata/link-local denial.
- [x] Worker-supplied results persist CollectorRun, optional MetricSample, and trigger configured metric alert evaluation.
- [ ] Production remote-agent threat-model peer review, firewall verification, secret vault integration, end-to-end TLS fixture test, performance/HA load and deployment sign-off.

Review: [PR #20](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/pull/20), [Agent quickstart](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/feat/secure-remote-collector-protocol/docs/REMOTE_AGENT_QUICKSTART.md).
